sokkel-egui.note: DescriptionList built before this spec, with columns 2 in the stacked layout (d163191); not yet compared with it.

sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: Facts about one thing as terms and values: a run's state and duration, a service's base address. A value that is missing is a quiet dash, never a blank. The pairs stand side by side (each term in a column beside its value, every pair sharing the list's term column), stacked (each term over its value) or in a row that wraps, for a strip of facts under a title; columns 2 sets the side and stacked pairs two to a row from md, and size sm fits a narrow inspector.

anatomy.list: The pairs: text.sm on 20 lines (sm: text.xs on 16), the rows 8 apart (sm: 4).
anatomy.term: A fact's term: text.xs in muted-foreground. Side by side, in the list's term column, as wide as termWidth.
anatomy.value: A fact's value in the list's text; in the code face where the fact says code, in tabular figures where it says numeric, wrapping anywhere it must. A value not given is a dash in faint.
anatomy.wide: A wide fact takes the list's full width: side by side its value goes under its term; in a two-column stacked list it spans both columns.

items.does: The facts, in order: { term, value, code?, numeric?, wide? }.

layout.does: side: each term in a column beside its value. stacked: each term over its value. row: the pairs one after another in a line that wraps.

columns.does: Two sets the side and stacked pairs two to a row from md (breakpoint-md); below it they stand one to a row.

termWidth.does: How wide the term column is side by side: a CSS length, or auto for as wide as the longest term (at most 40 percent of the list), so every value starts at one line.

size.does: sm sets the values at text.xs with tighter gaps, for a narrow inspector.

side.note: Between the term column and the values; sm 8. With columns 2, the two pairs 24 apart from md (sm 16).

stacked.note: Between the columns of a two-column list; sm 16. A term and its value 2 apart.

row.note: Between the pairs on a line, 4 between lines (sm: 16 and 2); a term and its value 6 apart.

rowGap.note: Between one row of pairs and the next (sm: 4).

termMax.note: With termWidth auto, the term column is as wide as the longest term, at most this share of the list.

missing.means: A fact with no value: a dash in faint.
missing.reached: a value null, undefined or empty

rest.note: In the ink of what it stands on.

sokkel-ui: A dl: side by side its pairs are subgrids of the list's tracks, so every term shares one column; in a DescriptionListGroup a one-column side list takes the group's term column, lining values up across what sits between the lists.
An InlineEdit value reaches into the gap so its text starts where a plain value's does.
parts/detail-pane draws each section's facts as this list, side by side.
